jobs.title: Hartgrove Hospital is hiring: Security Officer - Flex/PRN in Chicago
jobs.description:
RESPONSIBILITIES
JOB SUMMARY:
* Assures safe and secure environment.
* Guards, patrols, or monitors premises to prevent theft, violence, or infractions of rules.
* Patrols premises to prevent and detect signs of intrusion and ensure security of doors, windows, and gates.
* Answers alarms and investigate disturbances.
* Monitors and authorizes entrance and departure of employees, visitors, and other persons to guard against theft and maintains security of premises.
* Writes reports of daily activities and irregularities, such as equipment or property damage, theft, presence of unauthorized persons, or unusual occurrences.
* Calls police or fire departments in cases of emergency, such as fire or presence of unauthorized persons.
* Circulates among visitors, patrons, and employees to preserve order and protect property.
* Warns persons of rule infractions or violations, and apprehends or evicts violators from premises, using force when necessary.
* Operates detecting devices to screen individuals and prevents passage of prohibited articles into restricted areas.
- Performs duties while maintaining good service excellence and service recovery skills at all times.
Flex position - no benefits.
For information about the benefits we offer, please visit UHS Benefits Service Center.
QUALIFICATIONS
JOB SPECIFICATIONS:To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each primary duty satisfactorily.
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.
Education:High School Diploma.
Some College or Higher Education preferred.
Experience:Minimum 1 year experience in security, psychiatric or acute care hospital experience a plus.
Licensure/Certification:PERC card preferred, CPI a plus
Knowledge:Ability to communicate effectively.
Ability to interact effectively and politely with hospital staff, visitors, doctors, etc.
Supervision Received:Director of Security
- Working Conditions:Work hazards associated with potential misconduct in surrounding areas of the Hospital.
Exposure to agitated employees or guests who may exhibit violent/aggressive behavior.
General hospital environment.
Physical Requirements:Ability to communicate verbally, telephonically and in writing.
Physical agility to make Hospital perimeter rounds.
The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the primary functions.
Job Classification:Non-Exempt
This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by this employee.

The Security Officer has the responsibility of promoting a safe and secure environment for patients, visitors and staff at either the Chicago campus or the Hinsdale campus.
This is accomplished by patrolling the facility and campus, assuring that the building is secure, responding to emergency situations, taking charge during security incidents, reporting procedures & investigations, responding to special requests as well as performing other duties as assigned.
Reports to: Supervisor of Security and Director of Ancillary Services.
Supervises: None
PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
1.
Supports the Mission and Vision of RML Specialty Hospital by demonstrating RML's Core Values of Service, Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Respect and Stewardship (STAIRS) in all actions.
Promotes a positive patient/customer experience by exemplifying the principles of the Language of Caring in all interactions with patients, families and co-workers.
2.
- Performs security related activities as assigned to ensure a safe environment inside the hospital building and outside on the hospital campus.
3.
Responds to emergency situations or security threats in a professional manner, following established procedures.
4.
Participates in investigations of security incidents.
5.
Patrols the facility and campus at designated intervals to maintain order and prevent crime.
6.
Reports and documents any conditions that might constitute a security or safety hazard.
Documentation is accurate, complete, and timely.
7.
Assures that offices and departments are secure when vacant.
8.
Reports unsafe conditions as well as policy infractions, takes appropriate actions to resolve issues.
9.
Monitors video management system and takes appropriate actions to respond to any potential threats or unsafe incidents.
10.
Monitors door access control system and hospital lock-out system for breaches.
Ensures systems are in good working order at all times.
11.
Escorts employees and visitors throughout the campus and parking lots as required and requested.
12.
Requests support of area law enforcement agencies when required.
Cooperates fully with area law enforcement when present.
13.
- Provides a visible presence within facility.
14.
Monitors parking lot to ensure compliance with designated parking policies.
15.
Safely and courteously operates hospital vehicles, if needed.
16.
Relieves receptionist at front desk as assigned.
Relief duties include visitor registration, transferring of calls, and annunciation of codes as needed.
17.
- Maintains professional appearance which includes strict adherence to department uniform guidelines, including the issued vest, duty belt, and other equipment required to perform their job appropriately.
18.
Assists Office Services, Plant Operations, and EVS staff, if needed, which includes, but is not limited to, trash disposal and snow removal.
19.
Attends internal meetings and in-services and participates in mandatory reviews of policies and procedures.
20.
Supports the Mission and Vision of RML Specialty Hospital by demonstrating RML's Core Values of Service, Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Respect and Stewardship (STAIRS) in all actions.
Promotes a positive patient/customer experience by exemplifying the principles of the Language of Caring in all interactions with patients, families and coworkers.
21.
- Performs other duties as assigned, and as properly trained.
JOB REQUIREMENTS & CHARACTERISTICS
MINIMUMPREFERREDSkills & Abilities
* Ability to lift and carry 80 pounds
* Ability to walk, stand and climb stairs during most of shift.
* Physical ability to effectively address stressful situations, including combative patients, visitors, and employees
* Ability to respond quickly to emergencies, disasters, and other situations requiring physical assistance and a security presence.
* Good interpersonal, communication (written and verbal), teamwork, customer service, and problem solving skills.
Able to work effectively with coworkers.
Knowledge & Experience
* High school graduate or equivalent.
* Previous security experience.
* Computer skills
* Formal training in crisis intervention within 12 months of hire.
* One to two years experience in security in a health care environment.
* Experienced in using video management systems and access control systems.
* Defensive weapons training.
* Police officer training.
* Formal training in crisis intervention.
License/
Certification
* Valid Illinois Driver’s License
* PERC Card
- Working Conditions
* Potential for bodily harm from contact with combative patients, visitors, and staff.
* Potential exposure to hazardous, infectious, or biological materials.
* Exposure to inclement weather.

jobs.title: Lead Public Safety Officer, Swedish Hospital, Nights
jobs.description:
Hourly Pay Range:

$19.89 - $28.84 - The hourly pay rate offered is determined by a candidate's expertise and years of experience, among other factors.

Position Highlights:

  • Position: Lead Public Safety Officer
  • Location: Swedish Hospital
  • Full Time- 40hrs
  • Hours: Nights - 12am – 8:30am
  • Days: Sunday - Thursday

What you will do:

  • Demonstrates the knowledge and skills necessary to provide care appropriate to the age of patients served. This includes knowledge of the physical and psychological needs of patients served and the ability to respond appropriately to those needs.
  • In the absence of the Shift Supervisor coordinates the work of assigned department staff and determines daily work post assignments.
  • Assist the Shift Supervisor to trains and orient newly hired Security Officers on his/her shift.
  • Monitors Security Officers in performance of their duties and provides on-going direction of activities during the shift. Determines when an incident requires written report, which report form to use and submits to Supervisor, Public Safety. Prepare other written reports as directed.
  • Assist Shift Supervisor to coordinate interviews for investigations with employees and law enforcement agencies.
  • Briefs oncoming Lead Officer regarding any reports and pertinent information.
